status: frozen after retiring the MOND-BTFR-like mass scaling and before any NBM0 astrophysical fit
research_claim: A covariantly defined basin field sourced by density contrast changes both metric potentials through one physical metric, so massive-particle dynamics and lensing are derived responses rather than separately normalized laws.
field_equation: (Box-L_X^-2) X = -kappa_X (T-T_background)/M_Pl^2 with retarded cosmological boundary conditions
physical_metric: g_tilde_mn = exp(2 alpha X) [g_mn + 2 beta X U_m U_n], with U_m U^m=-1

special_limits.pure_conformal_beta_zero: q_X=0: the X response cancels from lensing
special_limits.alpha_equals_beta: dynamics is blind to X while lensing is not; ratio is singular

non_MON_D_boundary: Do not use a fitted mu(g/a0), RAR interpolation, BTFR exponent, or mass-velocity amplitude law as the NBM0 field equation.
Do not infer beta from CLASH alone; alpha and beta must be frozen jointly from same-system dynamics and lensing or derived from a completed action.
Do not treat the GR/NFW-deprojected CLASH acceleration summaries as a theory-neutral likelihood.
